g.text: ⚡ ai_trader_gemini: Quantitative Scoring & Compliance Decision Architecture
Deterministic 5-Pillar Quant + Quality/Vol Guard + 20% ML Hybrid (stock_ml) + Compliance Safety Gates
TRACK C: QUALITATIVE RAG & LLM ADVISOR
• Daily OHLCV Price Bars, EMA20, EMA50, EMA200
• SPDR Sector ETFs (XLK, XLC, etc.) & SPY Benchmark
Dynamic Re-weighting: W_A = Σ w_i across measured pillars
Stage B: Financial Quality & Value-Trap Guard
• Balance Sheet Solvency: Net Debt/EBITDA, OCF Margin
Directional BUYs mechanically vetoed to HOLD
Stage C: ATR% Volatility Factor Dampener
• Top 5 Performing ETFs: SMH, SOXX, XLK, SPMO, QQQ
• 25 Market Leaders: NVDA, AAPL, MSFT, AVGO, TSLA...
3. Freshness Gate: Scores > 7 days old are discarded
ml_weight automatically set to 0.0% for out-of-scope
• Official Company IR & Earnings Call Transcripts
• Market Agent: Technical patterns, volume & RSI
• News Agent: Catalyst scoring & headline verification
• Analyst Agent: Guidance shifts & earnings revisions
• Institutional Agent: 13F whale flow & insider buys
• Macro & Risk Agents: Treasury yield curve & blackouts
• Synthesizes multi-agent evidence and macro narrative
• Proposes Entry Price, Stop Loss, and Target Price
Candidate proposal is routed into Compliance Gates for validation.
STAGE D: ML HYBRID BLENDING & SCOPE RESOLUTION
• High-conviction alpha boost for modeled leaders
• Graceful degradation; ML score set to neutral 50.0
✓ LLM Proposed BUY + All 5 Gates Passed
• Stop loss safely outside option noise threshold
• Persisted to trader.db & Streamlit / Mobile UI
• Overrides glowing LLM thesis for capital protection
• Stop sits inside 1-SD option expected move
• Audit trail retained in database signal JSON
• Short: Overhead channel stop & support target
• Long Exit: Target reached or stop breach
